decision_basis: Purified or heterologous receptor binding, PDGF-BB-dependent PDGFRA activation, and downstream ERK/Akt/PLC-gamma and cell-response assays support the exact PDGF-BB-PDGFRA relay/function record.
PlGF-FLT1 binding, FLT1 phosphorylation, receptor cross-talk, and endothelial/vascular functional assays support the exact receptor-proximal relay/function record.
TGF-alpha-EGFR binding, EGFR tyrosine-phosphorylation/trafficking, kinase dependence, and growth-factor response assays support the exact receptor-proximal relay/function record.
